nodes.label: Pilot an AI support assistant?
nodes.description: FICTIONAL DEMO • Choose a safe first step for a small support team.

nodes.label: Human-reviewed pilot
nodes.description: Draft replies for staff approval. Keep a human responsible for every send.
nodes.rationale: Pick this if useful drafts can save review time without bypassing approval.

nodes.label: Automatic replies
nodes.description: Potentially faster, but reply quality has not been measured.
nodes.rationale: Revisit only after quality and escalation behavior are demonstrated.

nodes.label: Will the drafts be useful?
nodes.description: Proposed test: review 20 synthetic tickets; require 18 acceptable drafts and zero unsafe replies. This is a demo threshold, not a result.

gap.question: How many drafts pass human review on the synthetic test set?
